title: AEScorer: An Agentic Evidence-Grounded Framework for Graded Factuality Verification
abstract: arXiv:2601.03605v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Despite the significant advancements of Large Language Models (LLMs), their factuality remains a critical challenge, creating a growing need for more nuanced factuality verification. Existing factuality verification methods do not capture graded judgments, even though factuality is better understood as a spectrum rather than a binary of right and wrong. To bridge this gap, we focus on graded factuality verification and propose AEScorer, an agentic evidence-grounded framework with two stages: agentic evidence acquisition and graded scoring. translated_title: AEScorer：一种基于证据的代理式分级事实性验证框架
translated_abstract: 尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）取得了显著进展，但其事实性仍然是一个关键挑战，这导致了对更细致事实性验证的日益增长的需求。现有的事实性验证方法未能捕捉分级判断，尽管事实性更应被视为一个频谱而非对错的二元对立。为弥合这一差距，我们专注于分级事实性验证，并提出了AEScorer，一个基于证据的代理式框架，包含两个阶段：代理式证据获取和分级评分。AEScorer首先通过代理式搜索收集并精炼外部证据，然后预测一个标量事实性分数，以区分事实正确性的细微差异。我们进一步构建了GradedVeriBench，一个涵盖通用和多跳问答的分级事实性验证基准。在GradedVeriBench上的实验结果表明，AEScorer显著优于现有方法。
tldr: AEScorer提出了一种代理式证据获取与分级评分框架，用于区分事实性的细微差异，并通过新基准GradedVeriBench验证了其优越性能。
en_tdlr: AEScorer introduces an agentic evidence-grounded framework with graded scoring to capture nuanced factual differences, demonstrating superior performance on the new GradedVeriBench benchmark.
